name: tetris-lab-web
description: The Tetris Lab page: one wasm instance in one worker, Canvas 2D board. No runtime dependencies.

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:facts && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/manifest.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:facts && node --test "test/**/*.test.mjs"
scripts.gates: npm run build && npm run check:words && cargo test --workspace && node --test "test/**/*.test.mjs" && cargo run --release -p bench -- gate all
